tool.name: Pling align
tool.description: cluster complete plasmid sequences using alignment-based integerisation
tool.command:
mkdir -p inputs pling_out && python '$__tool_directory__/write_manifest.py' --output genomes_list.txt --input-dir inputs #for $i, $genome in enumerate($genomes) --genome '$genome' '$genome.element_identifier' #end for #if $topology.topology_source == "file" --topology-input '$topology.topology_file' --topology-output topology.tsv #end if && pling cluster align genomes_list.txt pling_out --cores \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} --containment_distance '$containment_distance' --dcj '$dcj' --batch_size '$advanced.batch_size' --identity '$advanced.identity' --min_indel_size '$advanced.min_indel_size' --bh_connectivity '$advanced.bh_connectivity' --bh_neighbours_edge_density '$advanced.bh_neighbours_edge_density' --small_subcommunity_size_threshold '$advanced.small_subcommunity_size_threshold' --visualisation '$visualisation.scope' #if $visualisation.scope == "none" --output_type html #else --output_type '$visualisation.output_type' #end if --ilp_solver GLPK #if $advanced.sourmash_prefilter.enabled == "yes" --sourmash --sourmash_threshold '$advanced.sourmash_prefilter.sourmash_threshold' #end if #if $topology.topology_source == "file" --topology topology.tsv #end if && graph_dir="pling_out/dcj_thresh_${dcj}_graph" && cp "\${graph_dir}/objects/typing.tsv" '$typing' && cp "\${graph_dir}/objects/hub_plasmids.csv" '$hub_plasmids' && cp pling_out/all_plasmids_distances.tsv '$distances' #if $visualisation.scope != "none" and ($visualisation.output_type == "json" or $visualisation.output_type == "both") && mkdir -p json_visualisations && for json_file in "\${graph_dir}"/visualisations/*/jsons/community_*.json; do json_name=\$(basename "\${json_file}"); cp "\${json_file}" "json_visualisations/\${json_name}"; done #if $visualisation.scope == "all" && for json_file in pling_out/containment/containment_communities/visualisations/communities/jsons/community_*.json; do json_name=\$(basename "\${json_file}"); cp "\${json_file}" "json_visualisations/containment_\${json_name}"; done #end if #end if #if $visualisation.scope != "none" and ($visualisation.output_type == "html" or $visualisation.output_type == "both") && mkdir -p '$html_visualisations.extra_files_path' && cp -r "\${graph_dir}/visualisations/." '$html_visualisations.extra_files_path'/ #if $visualisation.scope == "all" && cp -r pling_out/containment/containment_communities/visualisations/communities '${html_visualisations.extra_files_path}/containment_communities' #end if && printf '%s\n' \ '' \ '' \ '' \ ' ' \ ' Pling visualisations' \ '' \ '' \ '

Pling visualisations

' \ '
    ' \ #if $visualisation.scope == "all" '
  • Initial containment-network community visualisations
    • ' \ #end if '
  • DCJ-threshold community visualisations
    • ' \ '
  • DCJ-threshold subcommunity visualisations
    • ' \ '
' \ '' \ '' \ > '$html_visualisations' && python -c "import shutil, sys; shutil.make_archive('html_visualisations', 'zip', sys.argv[1])" '$html_visualisations.extra_files_path' && mv html_visualisations.zip '$html_visualisations_archive' #end if

param.name: genomes
param.label: Complete plasmid FASTA sequences
param.help: Use one complete plasmid sequence per FASTA or compressed FASTA dataset. Each collection element is written to the Pling manifest as one plasmid.

param.label: Containment distance threshold
param.help: Maximum containment distance between plasmids. Default: 0.5.

param.label: DCJ-Indel distance threshold
param.help: Maximum rearrangement distance used for clustering. Default: 4.

param.name: topology_source
param.label: Genome topology
param.help: Input sequences are assumed to be circular by default. Specify any sequences known to be linear. For Flye, check column 4 (Is circular, Y/N) in assembly_info.txt. For SPAdes, check GFA scaffold paths; TP:Z:circular marks circular paths. For Autocycler, use the reported topology or inspect the final GFA/FASTA. For NCBI-formatted FASTA, check the header for [topology=circular] or [topology=linear].

param.name: topology_file
param.label: Topology TSV
param.help: Tab-separated file with a header row and two columns: plasmid and topology. Include exactly one row for every input collection element, including circular plasmids. Each plasmid value must match a collection element identifier exactly, and topology must be circular or linear. If using Auto Build List, remove file extensions when the TSV omits them.

param.name: scope
param.label: Visualisation scope
param.option: All visualisations, including the initial containment network

param.label: Genome-pair batch size
param.help: Number of genome pairs processed together during alignment integerisation and DCJ calculation. Default: 200.

param.label: Minimum sequence identity for shared blocks (%)
param.help: Alignment identity threshold used while converting FASTA sequences into shared integerised blocks. Default: 80%.

param.label: Minimum indel block size (bp)
param.help: Minimum insertion/deletion block size considered during integerisation. Default: 200 bp.

param.label: Small subcommunity size threshold
param.help: Communities containing at most this many plasmids are joined to neighbouring larger subcommunities. Default: 4.

param.label: Hub plasmid minimum connectivity
param.help: Minimum connectivity used when identifying hub plasmids. Default: 10.

param.label: Maximum edge density among hub-plasmid neighbours
param.help: Maximum edge density among hub plasmid neighbours. Default: 0.2.

param.label: Sourmash prefilter threshold
param.help: Containment-like threshold used to prefilter plasmid pairs before alignment. Default: 0.85.

has_text.text: Topology TSV plasmid value does not match an input collection element: missing_plasmid

tool.help:
@HELP_OVERVIEW@
This wrapper runs ``pling cluster align``. Other Pling subcommands are not included.
**Inputs**
Supply a Galaxy list collection with one complete plasmid sequence per FASTA or compressed FASTA dataset. Draft assemblies, short contigs, and multi-plasmid FASTA files are not supported by this wrapper.
Before clustering, FASTA sequences are converted into integerised blocks using Pling's built-in alignment workflow.
By default, Pling treats every input plasmid as circular. If any inputs are known to be linear, provide a topology table with columns named ``plasmid`` and ``topology``. The table must contain exactly one row for every input, including circular plasmids. Plasmid names must match the input collection element identifiers exactly, and topology values must be ``circular`` or ``linear``.
**Key parameters**
``Containment distance threshold`` Maximum distance based on shared sequence content, calculated relative to the smaller plasmid.
``DCJ-Indel distance threshold`` Maximum rearrangement distance used when clustering plasmids after integerisation.
``Minimum sequence identity percentage for shared blocks`` Alignment identity threshold used while converting FASTA sequences into shared integerised blocks.
``Minimum indel block size`` Minimum insertion/deletion block size considered during integerisation.
**Main outputs**
* typing: plasmid-to-subcommunity assignments from ``typing.tsv``. * DCJ-Indel distances: pairwise distances from ``all_plasmids_distances.tsv``. * hub plasmids: hub plasmids from ``hub_plasmids.csv``. * HTML visualisations: a Galaxy HTML report linking to the final DCJ-threshold community and subcommunity graph pages. The initial containment-network community pages are also included when all visualisations are requested. * HTML visualisations archive: downloadable ZIP archive containing the same HTML visualisation files and assets. * JSON visualisations: Cytoscape graph JSON files collected using unique names. Initial containment-network communities are prefixed with ``containment_``.
The wrapper creates the ``genomes_list`` manifest internally from the selected Galaxy collection, sorting collection elements by identifier for reproducible Pling input order.
